nodes.title: Video source
widgets_values:
Load a video to copy here

You can right click on any video in windows, select copy as path.
Paste that into the video path to the right.

Frame rate
- Set fps of video here
- Using full, 1/2 or 1/4 of base is best 
- Because this is batched, you can do full 30 fps video or you can set 15 fps and interpolate the other.

Frame load cap
- Limit the frames you want to copy

Format should be wan.

nodes.title: Video controls
widgets_values:
This generates controls

DW pose
- this is fast and allows good changes to the subject.
- This face has issues with turning or side shots.

Open pose
- THis is slower but can offer different results.
- Face for this works better than dw pose but not perfect.

Can blend these two to combine face with body etc.

Depth 
- This can copy most videos but limits the changes you can do with the subject.
- Depth can be combined with others.  
- Depth can be combined with a black image, lowering its strength.


Face mesh, can help copy a face in replacement of openpose.

Lineart can work but it copies the subject of the video the most
Lineart can be generated from a depth map.  Allowing outlines to be used.

nodes.title: First Batch render
widgets_values:
This is your first batch render

This works just like a normal video but has a few options i added to allow a bit more control

Main prompts are used for all batches unless you edit them below.


This shows the total frames to render for the video and allows you to set the number of frames you want to batch.

Good batch counts are 49, 81 but can do any.

The control video is brought in here and cut to do the first batch only.  THe video preview should show the control for the batch.

The option for Use ref as first frame guide
This is optional and has rules to using it.

This inserts the ref image you provide as a start frame but it does so in a way that allows the image to not match the start frame exactly.

This inserts the ref image and 3 interpolation frames to the start.  These interpolation frames are just repeates of the first frame control.  This "can" allow the video to morph the ref image into the start frame if its close enough.

These starting 4 frames are removed from the video batch at the end.  They are used to guide the video only, and can help get a better copy of a ref image, expecially for 1.3b.

The better you match the start frame crop the better this works.  

Use the switch, bypassing the ref image insert does not work.

nodes.title: Model and lora Loading
widgets_values:
3 ways to load the models

Load diffusion model
This loads a normal model (non gguf) 

Unet Loader (GGUF)
This allows loading gguf models.

UnetLoaderGGUFDisTorchMultiGPU
This allow you to load a gguf and force offload some or all of the model to the ram.  Lower vram use, but slower.  This allows longer or larger videos at expense of speed.

Virtual ram gb - this is used to set how much of the model is sent to ram to be loaded when needed.

The GGUF Q8 is about 18-19gb.  
So setting 10 sends about 10 gb to ram and tries to load the rest in vram.

Setting 16 will mostly load the whole model into ram, and only load what it can into vram as it renders.
This works well but slows things down.

This number is determined by how large the model you are using is, and how much ram you have.
your model size - virtual ram gb = how much it tries to put into vram.



LORA

Causevid is a 8 step lora for wan.
This is loaded in the model only loader at 0.8 strength default

Accvid lora and movigen lora here
https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/tree/main


This lora can oversaturate videos color.  Lower strength or lower steps if you notice this.

Other loras
Any text to video lora (for the size of the model) works. 
Image to video loras do not work here.



Ensure the model / clip / vae are connected wtih the options you want to use.

Models and loras

https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/tree/main/split_files/diffusion_models

GGUF
https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Wan2.1-VACE-14B-GGUF/tree/main

Vace comfy info
https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/wan/vace

Vace 8 step loras
https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/tree/main


Text to video loras work, not image to video.
14b or 1.3b depending on what you are using.


Accvid lora and movigen lora here
https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/tree/main



New vace fusionx models with the loras included
Dont use the causvid other helper loras with these.

https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Wan2.1_T2V_14B_FusionX_VACE/tree/main

nodes.title: Models new info.
widgets_values:
Notes on extending with VACE 1.3b or 14b

Causvid can NOT extend.  It makes great videos and its a great lora.  But it contrast shifts start frames and makes stitching very noticable when extending.

Fusionx models have causvid included, they "can" work for 1-3 extends sometimes but they drift in contrast the further you get from the start video.

Self forcing mostly solves this but still not perfect.  

Using loras or full self forcing models.
Self forcing can limit motions. 

Its meant to use a low CFG - 1-3.  But raising it from 1 causes generation time to go way up.  However raising the cfg works well to force it to listen to your prompt more.  1 wont generate rain.  3 will generate rain.


14b self forcing

Any vace 14b model can use the 
Wan21_T2V_14B_lightx2v_cfg_step_distill_lora_rank32.safetensors
from
https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/tree/main

full model - 28gb
https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Wan2.1-T2V-14B-StepDistill-CfgDistill/tree/main

1.3b self forcing (fast and decent)
https://huggingface.co/lym00/Wan2.1_T2V_1.3B_SelfForcing_VACE/tree/main

Lora works with any vace 1.3b model and the model itself works alone.

I use gguf q8 14b with the lora and
I use 1.3b vace with lora or the full self forcing model.

I wish i could find a fp8 version of the self focing 14b...  the 1.3b model extends really well, but quality is not the best.


The best results

1.3b - self forcing lora at 0.6-1
14b - lightx2v at 0.6-1

nodes.title: After video fixes
widgets_values:
ALL this is done frame by frame to prevent memory issues.
HOWEVER.  I highly recommend you do not enable ANY of this until after you have a completed combined video below and saved it!

There is nothing worse than rendering 6 batches, and having something error or worse crash comfy and lose everything completed.

Save the completed video. before enabling this stuff.



Color match can help match batch colors if needed.
This is less needed with forced difusion loras over causvid

Upscale video does just that.
Use an upscale model and set the size you want to upscale to.

Face fixing is reactor face fix.
This can help if not planing on fixing faces another way.
You can test a frame with the face restore model to find one that works decent.

Interpolaton can 2-4x your frame rate.  rife 47 or 49 or film vfi.

nodes.title: REf images
widgets_values:
Here you load 1 or 2 ref images

The options for each are

Crop
- enable this and run the flow.
- right click on the image loaded in the preview
- open in mask editor
- circle what you want to crop
- save to node
- rerun flow

THis is used to crop the ref image to better show what you want to copy.

RemBG
- This is used to remove the background and place the subject on white.



Combine refs
- This combines 2 ref images into one to fit in the video frame.
- Left right can swap positions

Sizing
- This lets you crop or pad the ref image to match the video
- Use this to ensire your ref has the image you want to copy.


Removing background allows you to prompt location.

I have tested this quite a bit attempting to remove the contrast shift bettween batches.

That being said, ALL work.  you can pick any sampler and it works but the above happens.

nodes.title: Batching looping renders
widgets_values:
This is where we batch and loop through the video generations.

The batching info and prep can be enabled once you have a start batch completed.
This will show you all info needed for the next batch.

This does MANY things that many people wont be familiar with.

What this does

This grabs the next batch from the control video, inserts guide frames(last video frames) into the control video to guide the generation to start from the end of the last video batch.

The number of guide frames can be changed to what you wish.  1-12 seems fine, the more you add for guide frames the less frames you will actuall render, as all batches are set to your batch count.

If you set 81 frame batches then set 8 guide frames, you render 73 frames per batch, with the other 8 used only to guide.
The guides are removed from the finished batches for each.


Preview Batch control 
- this will show you the control used for the batch with the guide frames.

Info
Looped batches
- this shows how many batches you need to complete the video and how many loops will run.

Last batch count
- shows how many frames are in the last batch.  Having this too low can cause problems with the last batch render.

Current batch shows the batch currently being worked on

Frames total and frames this batch
This shows how many frames total and the current batch count.


I have added a replace prompts for batchs because sometimes you need to change the prompt in the middle.
This works by checking the batch and setting the prompt based on the batch index.
There are 2 sets here to change if you want, one or none can be used or you could make more.

Batch to change (batches index starts at 0) not 1.
This is the batch you want to change the prompt for, this will change the prompt for the batch you choose and will copy that prompt for any batches past this. This allows you to change the prompts and it holds the prompt change until you tell it otherwise.
